selection_reason: The current research ancestry carrier proves downstream correction wiring can compose, but the monolithic observation-use basis conflates transient live access loss, prospective mapping drift, and retrospective discovery that historical outcome labels were mis-grounded. This blocks lawful promotion and is directly load-bearing for correcting cognition after an experience-frame binding changes.
selected_first_discriminator: Given the same historical learned consequence relation, distinguish: (A) temporary observation access loss -> historical relation preserved; (B) prospective observation mapping epoch change after historically valid evidence -> history preserved but future use/revalidation requires fresh epoch/translation; (C) retrospective falsification of the historical actual-event admission basis -> dependent learned relation challenged with history preserved and fresh requalification debt. Existing capability/evidence/currentness machinery gets first refusal.

negative-control stability as universal disturbance absence
open_siblings: endogenous action/effect relational-algebra construction from opaque experience
actual-event causal attribution under exogenous disturbance outside tested negative-control coverage
deferred: whole-organism R2 retest until observation/frame premises materially improve
anti_rabbit: No historical-evidence manager, no retroactive evidence deletion, no fixed time decay, no PAL architecture transplant, no confidence threshold sweep; one bounded three-case discriminator first.
